# Alchetron

> > A free social encyclopedia providing comprehensive biographical, cultural, and historical information across entertainment, arts, sports, and notable figures worldwide.

Alchetron serves as a collaborative knowledge platform offering detailed encyclopedia entries on diverse topics including musicians, authors, actors, athletes, historical sites, television shows, albums, and cultural phenomena. The site aggregates information with a focus on biographies and cultural content, making it accessible for research and discovery.

## Key Topics

- Biography and notable figures
- Mystery novels and detective fiction
- Music albums and artists
- Television shows and entertainment
- Turkish culture and personalities
- Archaeological sites and history
- Sue Grafton Alphabet series
- Kinsey Millhone detective novels
- Folk and contemporary music
- International cinema and actors
- Sports figures and organizations
- Neoclassical architecture
- Social encyclopedia platform
- Cultural knowledge sharing

## Home

- [Alchetron, Free Social Encyclopedia for The World](https://alchetron.com): Homepage of Alchetron social encyclopedia for movies, biographies & more

## Literature and Mystery Novels

- ["O" Is for Outlaw](https://alchetron.com/%22O%22-Is-for-Outlaw): Sue Grafton's 15th Kinsey Millhone mystery novel set in Santa Teresa
- ["S" Is for Silence](https://alchetron.com/%22S%22-Is-for-Silence): Sue Grafton's 19th Alphabet series mystery alternating between 1953-1987

## Music and Albums

- ["I Luv You HB" Demos](https://alchetron.com/%22I-Luv-You-HB%22-Demos): J. Tillman's cassette demo collection for Sub Pop's I Love You, Honeybear
- ["No Snow, No Show" for the Eskimo](https://alchetron.com/%22No-Snow%2C-No-Show%22-for-the-Eskimo): The Mission's 1993 live album from BBC Radio One recordings at Wembley
- ["Straightaway" Jazz Themes](https://alchetron.com/%22Straightaway%22-Jazz-Themes): Maynard Ferguson's 1961 Roulette jazz album for TV series Straightaway
- ['92 Tour EP](https://alchetron.com/%2792-Tour-EP): Motörhead's final WTG EP from 1992 tour sessions with Ozzy Osbourne
- [&Music](https://alchetron.com/%26Music): Zee Entertainment's Hindi-English music channel headquartered in Noida

## Television and Entertainment

- [$40 a Day](https://alchetron.com/%2440-a-Day): Rachael Ray's Food Network budget travel dining show across US & Europe
- [Øyevitne](https://alchetron.com/%C3%98yevitne): Norwegian NRK crime drama remade as USA Network's Eyewitness in 2016

## Biographies and Notable Figures

- [Çiğdem y Mirol](https://alchetron.com/%C3%87i%C4%9Fdem-y-Mirol): Turkish contemporary artist from Ankara pioneering book-performance art
- [Éder Aleixo de Assis](https://alchetron.com/%C3%89der-Aleixo-de-Assis): Brazilian footballer Éder Assis who played for Grêmio and 1982 World Cup
- [Édgar Ponce](https://alchetron.com/%C3%89dgar-Ponce): Mexican actor/dancer from Sólo Para Mujeres who died in 2005 accident
- [Étienne Hippolyte Godde](https://alchetron.com/%C3%89tienne-Hippolyte-Godde): French neoclassical architect who designed 30+ Paris religious buildings
- [Özlem Conker](https://alchetron.com/%C3%96zlem-Conker): Turkish actress from Ankara famous for role as Nazar in Kinali Kar
- [Şenes Erzik](https://alchetron.com/%C5%9Eenes-Erzik): UEFA vice president and FIFA Council member from Giresun, Turkey
- ['Abd al Hayy](https://alchetron.com/%27Abd-al-Hayy): Persian illustrator trained in Baghdad, died in Samarkand 1405

## History and Archaeology

- ['Ain Ghazal](https://alchetron.com/%27Ain-Ghazal): Neolithic archaeological site near Amman Civil Airport in Jordan
- ['Atara](https://alchetron.com/%27Atara): Palestinian village 15km north of Ramallah in West Bank with 2,300 people

## Optional

- ['47 (magazine)](https://alchetron.com/%2747-%28magazine%29): American writer-owned cooperative magazine from 1947-1948 postwar era
